Package.Name: TPLinkSmartHome
Package.Author: Elie Bertret
Package.Description: Discover and control TP-Link Kasa/Tapo devices on the local network (legacy, KLAP and TPAP protocols)

Setting.name: poolingInterval
Setting.description: How often (ms) to refresh the state of already-discovered devices

Setting.name: discoveryIntervalMs
Setting.description: How often (ms) to re-broadcast a LAN discovery pass to find new/moved devices. Can be forced early via the ForceDiscovery message handler.

Setting.name: Username
Setting.description: TP-Link/Kasa account email - required by KLAP/TPAP-authenticated devices (2023+ Kasa firmware, all Tapo devices). Same credential as the Kasa/Tapo mobile app.
